findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_elements, get_changes, get_draught, get_image_upload_ticket · Private data: get_changes, list_files, read_file · Public sink: create_element, bulk_apply, get_image_upload_ticket · Destructive: get_changes, edit_links, bulk_apply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_elements, get_changes, get_draught, get_image_upload_ticket · Private data: get_changes, list_files, read_file · Public sink: create_element, bulk_apply, get_image_upload_ticket · Destructive: get_changes, edit_links, bulk_apply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
